purpose: Acceptance criteria 1-3 of syzygy-3efd.22 shown on a synthetic state root, because the real one could not be read from this session (it is outside the agent user's home). Not the baseline: no real draft is measured here. Regenerated after the review repairs (notes 1-8); this file replaces the first demonstration.

subject.what: a scratch state root of synthetic drafts: one run directory with two frozen revisions (one admitted, one the schema refuses), a next.json, and a run-*.agents directory beside it
subject.generator: the Node script in generatorSource, run as `node <generator> <empty dir>`: schema-v2 drafts with two produced flow figures of 3 and 8 nodes

notRendered: no page HTML is rendered: a page needs the quoted sources, which come from the clone, and this instrument reads no repository. Each figure is laid out and drawn by the site renderer's own figure path; the ledger and figure fit are what check computes from the draft with that layout
